Alex / Maria —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Attached is our draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a first-pass evaluation plan geared to the proof-of-concept and exec-buy-in stages. Two asks as we lock the close timeline:

1) Executive sponsor mapping — can you confirm who from Acme will attend the executive briefing (EB)? We mapped likely stakeholders (CFO, SVP Clinical Ops, Head of IT) in the deck but want to make sure we have the right names and decision authority.

2) EB timing — below are 3 proposed 60–75 minute EB slots next week. Please pick your preferred slot and confirm attendee list so we can finalize the invite and pre-read:
   - Tue 24 Feb, 10:00–11:15 PT
   - Wed 25 Feb, 13:00–14:15 PT
   - Thu 26 Feb, 08:30–09:45 PT

Attached: redwood_map_v1.2.pdf (MAP with milestones & owners), evaluation_plan_acme.xlsx (scoring rubric + test datasets).

I’ve CC’d Marissa and Karthik to coordinate the EB agenda and technical attendance. If helpful we can split the EB into two parts: exec-level business + technical breakout.

Next steps: if you confirm sponsor and preferred slot I’ll send a calendar invite and short pre-read that calls out success criteria tied to the evaluation plan.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Soojin — this looks useful. Quick answers:

- Executive sponsor: our CFO Sarah Bennett will own commercial approvals; she indicated she wants the VP of Clinical Ops to weigh in on workflow impact. I’m looping in Dr. Emily Chen (Clinical Ops) to see if she can join the EB; Maria can confirm.

- Preferred slot: Tue 24 Feb, 10:00–11:15 PT works best for the core group.

A couple of asks from our side before the EB:
  * Can you include a one-page ops risk register in the MAP that lists data residency and audit log commitments?
  * For the evaluation plan, can you add acceptance thresholds (pass/fail) for latency and false-positive rate on the sample set? That will speed internal sign-off.

I’ll follow up with Sarah and confirm whether Procurement will require a separate pre-procurement meeting.

—Alex
